attributes.name: initial_risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk rating derived from the combination of initial_risk_likelihood and initial_risk_consequence before any control measures are applied. Represents the inherent risk level of the activity.

attributes.name: intelex_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique record identifier assigned by the Intelex HSE Management system for this SWMS. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the SWMS was formally issued and approved for use on site. Represents the principal business event date for this document.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the SWMS was most recently reviewed and confirmed as current and applicable. Updated each time a formal review is completed, even if no changes are made to the document content.

attributes.name: plant_equipment_required
attributes.description: List of plant, equipment, and tools required to perform the high-risk activity safely as described in this SWMS (e.g., EWP, crane, excavator, scaffolding, welding equipment). Supports equipment deployment planning.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Enumerated list of mandatory Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) items required for personnel performing the activity covered by this SWMS (e.g., hard hat, safety harness, respirator, face shield, cut-resistant gloves). Aligns with PPE compliance tracking in Intelex.

attributes.name: ptw_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Permit to Work (PTW) must be issued and active before the activity described in this SWMS can commence. True for activities such as confined space entry, hot works, and electrical isolation.

attributes.name: ptw_type
attributes.description: Type of Permit to Work (PTW) required in conjunction with this SWMS. Populated only when ptw_required is True. Drives the PTW issuance workflow in Intelex.

attributes.name: residual_risk_consequence
attributes.description: Consequence severity rating after all control measures have been applied. Combined with residual_risk_likelihood to produce the residual risk rating.

attributes.name: residual_risk_likelihood
attributes.description: Likelihood rating of the hazard materialising after all control measures have been applied. Used to assess the effectiveness of controls and determine if the residual risk is acceptable.

attributes.name: residual_risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk rating after all control measures have been applied. Represents the residual risk level that must be accepted or further mitigated before work can proceed. Extreme residual risk requires escalation to HSE Manager.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date by which the SWMS must be reviewed and re-validated for continued applicability. Triggers review workflow in Intelex when the date is reached or when site conditions change materially.

attributes.name: revision_number

attributes.name: swms_number

attributes.description: Date and time at which this SWMS record was most recently modified in the system. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse.

products.name: risk_assessment
products.description: Unified hazard and risk register serving as the single source of truth for all identified hazards and their risk evaluations across construction project sites. Captures hazard identification (type: fall, struck-by, caught-between, electrocution, excavation collapse, chemical exposure, environmental), activity/task scope, site location/zone, initial risk rating (likelihood x consequence matrix), control hierarchy applied (eliminate/substitute/engineer/admin/PPE), residual risk rating, control measures in place, responsible party, status (open/controlled/eliminated/closed), source (inspection/incident/design review/JHA), review date, and approver. Serves triple purpose: (1) formal risk assessment for specific activities supporting SWMS development and PTW issuance, (2) live site hazard inventory (hazard register) supporting daily pre-start briefings and toolbox meeting topic selection, and (3) Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) documentation for task-level risk evaluation. Maintains hazard register entries as living records updated through inspections, incidents, and periodic reviews. SSOT for all identified hazards, risk evaluations, and control effectiveness across the project portfolio.

attributes.description: Name of the authorised approver (typically HSE Manager or Project Manager) who reviewed and formally approved this risk assessment record.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk assessment was formally conducted and documented. Represents the principal business event date for this record.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference number assigned to this risk assessment record, used in SWMS, PTW, and HSE correspondence. Format: RA-{ProjectCode}-{Sequence}.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk assessment record: Open (hazard identified, controls not yet fully implemented), Controlled (controls in place, residual risk tolerable), Eliminated (hazard fully removed), Closed (no longer applicable), or Under Review (being reassessed).

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purpose and context of this risk assessment: Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) for task-level evaluation, SWMS support, PTW issuance support, design review, field inspection, or derived from an incident investigation.

attributes.name: control_hierarchy
attributes.description: Highest level of the Hierarchy of Controls applied to this hazard: Eliminate, Substitute, Engineering controls, Administrative controls, or Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Reflects the most effective control measure in place.

attributes.name: control_measures
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of all control measures implemented to eliminate or reduce the risk, including engineering controls, administrative procedures, PPE requirements, and any combination of controls applied.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a corrective action has been raised against this risk assessment due to inadequate controls or elevated residual risk (True = corrective action required). Triggers workflow in Intelex.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk assessment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: environmental_aspect
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk assessment includes an environmental aspect or impact in addition to occupational health and safety considerations (True = environmental component present). Supports ISO 14001 compliance.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_description
attributes.description: Description of the environmental impact or aspect associated with this hazard, where applicable (e.g., soil contamination from chemical spill, noise pollution, stormwater runoff). Populated when environmental_aspect is True.

attributes.name: hazard_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified hazard, including the source, agent, or condition that has the potential to cause harm or adverse health effects.

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hazard category identified in this assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fall|struck_by|caught_between|electrocution|excavation_collapse|chemical_exposure|environmental|fire_explosion|manual_handling|noise_vibration|biological|radiation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: initial_consequence
attributes.description: Consequence/severity score assigned before control measures are applied, rated on the project risk matrix scale (typically 1–5: 1=Insignificant, 2=Minor, 3=Moderate, 4=Major, 5=Catastrophic).

attributes.name: initial_likelihood
attributes.description: Likelihood score assigned before control measures are applied, rated on the project risk matrix scale (typically 1–5: 1=Rare, 2=Unlikely, 3=Possible, 4=Likely, 5=Almost Certain).

attributes.name: initial_risk_level
attributes.description: Qualitative risk band derived from the initial risk score using the project risk matrix (e.g., Low, Medium, High, Extreme). Used for prioritisation and reporting before controls are applied.

attributes.name: initial_risk_score
attributes.description: Pre-control risk score calculated as the product of initial likelihood and initial consequence ratings (Likelihood × Consequence). Represents the inherent risk level before any controls are applied.

attributes.name: intelex_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the corresponding record in the Intelex HSE Management system, used for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability between the lakehouse and the operational system of record.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this risk assessment record was most recently reviewed and updated. Supports audit trail and demonstrates ongoing management of the living hazard register.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which this risk assessment must be reviewed and updated to ensure continued relevance and effectiveness of control measures. Triggered by elapsed time, scope change, or incident.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Specific Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) items mandated for personnel performing the activity associated with this hazard (e.g., hard hat, safety harness, chemical-resistant gloves, respirator, safety glasses).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Specific regulatory standard, clause, or legal obligation that this risk assessment addresses (e.g., OSHA 29 CFR 1926.502 Fall Protection, ISO 45001 Clause 6.1.2, EPA 40 CFR). Supports compliance reporting.

attributes.name: residual_consequence
attributes.description: Consequence/severity score after all control measures have been applied, rated on the project risk matrix scale (typically 1–5). Reflects the remaining severity of harm post-control.

attributes.name: residual_likelihood
attributes.description: Likelihood score after all control measures have been applied, rated on the project risk matrix scale (typically 1–5). Reflects the remaining probability of the hazard being realised post-control.

attributes.name: residual_risk_level
attributes.description: Qualitative risk band derived from the residual risk score using the project risk matrix (e.g., Low, Medium, High, Extreme). Determines whether the risk is tolerable and whether additional controls are required.

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Post-control risk score calculated as the product of residual likelihood and residual consequence ratings (Likelihood × Consequence). Represents the remaining risk after all controls are applied.

attributes.name: responsible_party_role
attributes.description: Job role or organisational function of the person responsible for implementing and monitoring the control measures associated with this risk assessment.

attributes.name: risk_matrix_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the project or corporate risk matrix used to score likelihood and consequence for this assessment. Ensures consistent interpretation of risk scores across assessments and over time.

attributes.name: site_zone
attributes.description: Specific site area, zone, level, or grid reference where the hazard exists or the activity is performed (e.g., Zone A, Level 3, Grid B4, Excavation Area 2).

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Origin or trigger that led to the identification and recording of this hazard — e.g., field inspection, incident investigation, design review, JHA session, HSE audit, near-miss report, or Toolbox Meeting (TBM). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inspection|incident|design_review|jha|audit|near_miss|toolbox_meeting — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk assessment record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and the living hazard register update cycle.

Serves as the operational SSOT for site hazard visibility, supports daily pre-start briefings, and feeds toolbox meeting topic selection.

attributes.name: actual_closure_date

attributes.name: affected_workers_count

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the hazard record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping requirements.

attributes.name: environmental_aspect
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hazard also constitutes an environmental aspect with potential environmental impact (e.g., chemical spill risk, dust generation, noise pollution). True = environmental aspect present. Supports ISO 14001 environmental management integration.

attributes.name: hazard_category
attributes.description: Broad category grouping the hazard by agent type for aggregate HSE reporting and trend analysis. Supports ISO 45001 hazard identification and risk assessment processes.

attributes.name: hazard_description

attributes.name: hazard_reference_number

attributes.name: hazard_status

attributes.name: hazard_title

attributes.name: hierarchy_of_controls

attributes.name: identification_source

attributes.name: initial_risk_level

attributes.name: initial_risk_score

attributes.name: intelex_record_reference

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the precise physical location of the hazard within the site zone (e.g., 'North face of pier 3, 2m from edge', 'Adjacent to transformer substation'). Complements site_zone for field navigation.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory review of this hazard record. Drives automated review reminders and overdue review reporting in the Intelex HSE system.

attributes.name: permit_to_work_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Permit to Work (PTW) is mandatory before any work activity associated with this hazard can commence. True = PTW required (e.g., confined space entry, hot work, electrical isolation). Integrates with Intelex Permit to Work module.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements

attributes.name: residual_likelihood_rating

attributes.name: residual_risk_level

attributes.name: site_zone

attributes.name: swms_reference

attributes.name: target_closure_date

attributes.name: tbm_topic_flag

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.work_front. Business justification: Environmental monitoring (dust, noise, vibration) is conducted at specific work fronts generating the emissions. Linking monitoring records to work_front enables exceedance attribution to specific wor

attributes.name: corrective_action_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the corrective action record raised in Intelex HSE management system in response to this monitoring exceedance. Provides traceability between the environmental measurement and the remediation workflow.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a corrective action has been raised or is required as a result of this monitoring record. True = corrective action initiated in Intelex; False = no corrective action required. Populated automatically when exceedance_flag is True or manually by the HSE officer.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this environmental monitoring record was first created and entered into the system (Intelex or source system). Audit trail field for data governance and regulatory record-keeping requirements.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality assurance flag indicating the reliability and validity of the measurement value. 'Suspect' indicates potential instrument malfunction or anomalous conditions; 'Below Detection Limit' indicates the parameter was not detectable at the instrument's minimum detection level. Used in QA/QC review.

attributes.name: detection_limit
attributes.description: The minimum detection limit (MDL) of the instrument or analytical method for this parameter, expressed in the same unit as measurement_value. Used to contextualise results flagged as 'below_detection_limit' and for regulatory reporting of non-detects.

attributes.name: exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recorded measurement value has exceeded (or fallen below, for minimum thresholds) the applicable regulatory or permit threshold limit. True = exceedance detected; False = within acceptable limits. Triggers corrective action workflow in Intelex.

attributes.name: exceedance_magnitude
attributes.description: The absolute difference between the measured value and the threshold limit when an exceedance is detected. Null when exceedance_flag is False. Used to prioritise severity of environmental non-compliance and escalation response.

attributes.name: instrument_calibration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the monitoring instrument was last calibrated prior to this measurement. Used to verify that measurements were taken with a calibrated instrument within the required calibration interval, supporting regulatory defensibility.

attributes.name: instrument_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the monitoring instrument must next be calibrated to remain within its valid calibration period. Measurements taken after this date may be flagged as non-compliant for regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: instrument_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier or asset tag of the instrument, sensor, or analyser used to take the measurement (e.g., dust monitor serial number, noise meter ID, water quality probe ID). Supports instrument calibration traceability and equipment maintenance records.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the instrument or sensor type used for the measurement (e.g., 'Dust Monitor', 'Sound Level Meter', 'Vibration Meter', 'Multi-parameter Water Quality Probe', 'Gas Analyser'). Used for equipment management and calibration scheduling. attributes.name: laboratory_name

attributes.name: laboratory_report_number
attributes.description: The unique report or chain-of-custody number issued by the analytical laboratory for the sample analysis. Provides traceability from the field sample to the laboratory result and supports regulatory audit documentation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: latitude

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the monitoring point where the measurement was taken. Supports GIS-based environmental impact mapping and spatial analytics.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the environmental measurement or reading was taken in the field. This is the principal real-world event time, distinct from record creation audit timestamps. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the recorded measurement value (e.g., µg/m³, mg/L, dB(A), mm/s, NTU, pH, ppm, mg/kg). Must align with the unit specified in the applicable environmental permit or regulatory standard for the parameter. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: µg/m³|mg/L|dB(A)|mm/s|NTU|pH|ppm|mg/kg|µS/cm|°C — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: measurement_value
attributes.description: The numeric reading or measured value recorded for the environmental parameter at the monitoring location and timestamp. This is the principal quantitative observation for this record. Precision to 6 decimal places to accommodate trace-level contaminant readings.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The required or actual frequency at which measurements are taken at this monitoring location for this parameter, as specified in the environmental monitoring plan or regulatory permit. Used to verify compliance with permit monitoring schedules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuous|hourly|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|event_triggered — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: monitoring_location_code

attributes.name: monitoring_location_name

attributes.name: monitoring_method

attributes.name: monitoring_parameter

attributes.name: monitoring_reference_number

attributes.name: parameter_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the environmental monitoring parameter into the primary environmental media or impact category. Used for domain-level reporting and ISO 14001 environmental aspect categorisation.

attributes.name: regulator_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exceedance or monitoring result was formally notified to the relevant regulatory authority. Null if reported_to_regulator is False. Used to verify compliance with permit notification timeframes.

attributes.name: regulatory_standard_reference
attributes.description: The specific regulatory standard, guideline, or code of practice that defines the threshold limit for this parameter (e.g., 'EPA NAAQS PM10 150 µg/m³ 24-hr', 'OSHA PEL 1910.1000 Table Z-1', 'ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.1.1'). Provides traceability for threshold values used in exceedance determination.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for the monitoring officer to record contextual observations, anomalies, site conditions, or explanatory notes relevant to this measurement (e.g., 'Elevated reading attributed to adjacent demolition activity', 'Instrument battery low during measurement'). attributes.name: reported_to_regulator

attributes.name: sample_duration_minutes

attributes.name: sample_type

Affects interpretation of results.

attributes.name: threshold_limit

attributes.name: weather_conditions

attributes.name: budget_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this cost code can have budget allocated to it. Typically True for leaf-level codes and False for parent/rollup codes.

attributes.name: capitalization_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether costs posted to this code should be capitalized as assets on the balance sheet rather than expensed. Critical for Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) projects and asset-intensive developments.

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: The primary classification of the cost code into major expenditure categories. Used for high-level financial reporting and Profit and Loss (P&L) analysis.

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric cost code identifier used across all project accounting systems. This is the externally-known business identifier used in SAP S/4HANA Project Systems and Viewpoint Vista for budget allocation and actual cost posting.

attributes.name: cost_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost code. Active codes are available for budget allocation and cost posting. Inactive codes are retained for historical reporting but cannot be used for new transactions. Deprecated codes have been superseded by newer classifications.

attributes.name: cost_posting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether actual costs can be posted directly to this cost code. Typically True for detailed codes and False for summary/rollup codes.

attributes.name: cost_type
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the cost is directly attributable to a specific project deliverable (direct) or allocated across multiple activities (indirect/overhead). Critical for job costing and Earned Value Management (EVM) calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost code record was first created in the system. Part of the standard audit trail for master data management.

attributes.name: csi_division
attributes.description: The two-digit CSI MasterFormat division number (00-49) that this cost code maps to. Provides standardized alignment with construction specifications and Bill of Quantities (BOQ) structures.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cost code explaining the scope of work, materials, or services covered by this classification. Provides additional context beyond the name for proper cost allocation.

attributes.name: discipline_code
attributes.description: The engineering or construction discipline associated with this cost code (e.g., 'CIVIL', 'STRUCT', 'MECH', 'ELEC', 'INST' for Mechanical Electrical Plumbing (MEP) disciplines). Used for discipline-specific cost tracking and resource planning.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this cost code is no longer active for new transactions. Null for currently active codes. Used for cost code retirement and historical reporting.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost code becomes active and available for use in budget allocation and cost posting. Supports time-based cost code structures and phased project implementations.

attributes.name: evm_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether costs posted to this code are included in Earned Value Management (EVM) calculations including Cost Performance Index (CPI) and Schedule Performance Index (SPI) metrics.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this cost code in the source system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Cost Element number, Viewpoint Vista Cost Code ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this cost code record. Used for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost code record was last modified. Part of the standard audit trail for master data management and change tracking.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this cost code within the Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS). Typically ranges from 1 (top-level category) to 4 (detailed line item). Level 1 might be 'Labor', Level 2 'Structural Labor', Level 3 'Steel Erection Labor'.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost code providing human-readable identification of the cost category (e.g., 'Structural Steel Erection', 'Concrete Formwork Labor', 'Electrical Conduit Installation').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, usage guidelines, or special instructions related to this cost code. Provides context for proper application and interpretation.

attributes.name: parent_cost_code
attributes.description: The cost code of the parent category in the hierarchical Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS). Null for top-level cost codes. Enables roll-up reporting and hierarchical budget analysis.

attributes.name: rate_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard rate (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Required for multi-currency projects and international joint ventures.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used for revenue recognition associated with this cost code. Percentage of completion is the most common method for construction projects under IFRS 15 and ASC 606.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this cost code was originally sourced or is mastered. Supports multi-system integration and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: standard_rate
attributes.description: The standard cost rate per unit of measure for this cost code. Used for budget estimation, variance analysis, and Earned Value Management (EVM) calculations. May represent labor rate per hour, material cost per unit, or equipment rate per day.

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the tax treatment for costs posted to this cost code (e.g., 'TAXABLE', 'EXEMPT', 'ZERO_RATED'). Used for Value Added Tax (VAT) and sales tax compliance in multi-jurisdiction projects.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The standard unit of measure for quantity tracking associated with this cost code (e.g., 'hours' for labor, 'cubic yards' for concrete, 'linear feet' for piping, 'each' for equipment). Used for productivity analysis and Material Take-Off (MTO) reconciliation.

attributes.name: wbs_compatible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this cost code can be directly linked to Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) elements in Oracle Primavera P6 and SAP S/4HANA Project Systems for integrated schedule and cost management.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this cost code record in the system. Used for audit trail and data governance.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Organizational unit master representing financial responsibility centers within the construction enterprise — project cost centers, regional offices, corporate overhead centers, and shared-service centers. Maps to SAP S/4HANA cost center accounting (CO-CCA) and serves as the primary dimension for internal P&L reporting, overhead allocation, and EBITDA decomposition. Each cost center has a responsible manager, validity period, and hierarchy assignment.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cost_center

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: Required for Cost Center Allocation Report per client, enabling profitability analysis by linking each cost center to the client account it serves.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: cost_center has a company_code STRING column but no FK to the company_code master. In SAP controlling (CO), every cost center belongs to exactly one company code (legal entity). This is a fundamental

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting for regional, divisional, and corporate-level P&L (Profit and Loss) and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization) analysis. Nullable for top-level cost centers.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to allocate or distribute costs from this cost center to other cost objects (projects, WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) elements, or profit centers). Direct charge posts costs explicitly; activity-based uses cost drivers; headcount and square footage are common overhead allocation bases; revenue-based allocates proportionally to project revenue; none indicates no allocation (terminal cost center).

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The approved annual or period budget allocated to this cost center. Used for budget vs. actual variance reporting, CPI (Cost Performance Index) calculation in EVM (Earned Value Management), and financial forecasting.

attributes.name: budget_period
attributes.description: The time horizon for which the budget amount is defined. Annual budgets align with fiscal year planning; quarterly and monthly budgets support rolling forecasts; project lifecycle budgets span the duration of a construction project from NTP (Notice to Proceed) to handover.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business segment or division to which this cost center is assigned (e.g., Infrastructure, Energy, Commercial, Residential). Used for segment reporting under IFRS 8 and internal divisional P&L (Profit and Loss) analysis.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Accounting classification of the cost center for financial treatment. Direct centers charge costs to specific projects or WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) elements; indirect centers allocate costs via overhead rates; overhead centers represent corporate G&A (General and Administrative); capitalized centers accumulate costs for asset creation; expensed centers flow directly to P&L (Profit and Loss).

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code identifying the cost center in financial systems and reports. Used in SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA (Cost Center Accounting) for posting and reporting. Typically follows organizational coding standards (e.g., project-based, regional, functional).

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) area to which this cost center belongs. Controlling areas represent organizational units for internal management accounting and can span multiple company codes. Used for cross-company cost center reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: cost_center_group
attributes.description: A user-defined grouping or classification for aggregating related cost centers in reports (e.g., all regional offices, all project cost centers for a specific client, all MEP (Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing) cost centers). Used for flexible reporting hierarchies beyond the standard organizational structure.

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active centers accept postings; inactive centers are temporarily disabled; planned centers are approved but not yet operational; closed centers are archived and no longer accept transactions; suspended centers are on hold pending review or restructuring.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by its primary business function. Project cost centers track job-specific costs; regional offices track geographic operations; corporate overhead captures non-project administrative costs; shared services represent centralized functions (IT, HR, Finance); support functions include PMO (Project Management Office), procurement, and QA/QC (Quality Assurance/Quality Control); operational centers track site-level or equipment-based activities.

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: The primary cost element group or cost category that this cost center typically incurs (e.g., labor, materials, equipment, subcontractor, overhead). Used for cost structure analysis and variance reporting by cost type.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who created this cost center record. Used for accountability, audit trails, and access control reviews.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails, data lineage tracking, and compliance with financial record-keeping regulations.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this cost center's budget and actuals are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency consolidation and foreign exchange variance analysis.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Extended free-text description providing additional context about the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities. Used for documentation, audit trails, and onboarding new finance team members.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The primary functional discipline or department this cost center supports. Used for cross-project functional cost analysis, overhead allocation, and shared-service chargeback models. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engineering|procurement|construction|quality|safety|finance|hr|it|legal|admin — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The depth of this cost center in the organizational hierarchy tree. Level 1 represents corporate or top-level centers; higher numbers represent nested project, site, or functional centers. Used for drill-down reporting and aggregation logic.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs incurred in this cost center are billable to external clients or internal projects. True for project cost centers with reimbursable contracts; false for corporate overhead and non-billable support functions. Used for revenue recognition and progress billing logic.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who last modified this cost center record. Used for change accountability, audit trails, and data quality investigations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is locked for new postings. True when the cost center is under audit, pending closure, or frozen for period-end reporting. Used to enforce financial controls and prevent unauthorized transactions.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center, used for human-readable identification in financial reports, dashboards, and P&L (Profit and Loss) statements.

attributes.name: overhead_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The standard overhead rate (as a percentage) applied to direct costs posted to this cost center. Used for indirect cost allocation, GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price) contract pricing, and full absorption costing. Nullable for cost centers that do not apply overhead rates.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter code representing the geographic region or country where this cost center operates (e.g., USA, GBR, ARE). Used for regional P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting, tax jurisdiction mapping, and geographic segment analysis.

attributes.name: site_location
attributes.description: The physical site, office, or facility location associated with this cost center. Used for site-level cost tracking, field operations reporting, and HSE (Health Safety and Environment) cost allocation.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center becomes effective and can accept financial postings. Used for time-dependent cost center master data and period-based reporting.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this cost center remains effective. Nullable for open-ended cost centers. Used to manage cost center lifecycle, project closeout, and organizational restructuring.

products.name: gl_account
products.description: General Ledger chart of accounts master defining every account used in the construction enterprise's financial statements — revenue accounts, cost-of-construction accounts, overhead, assets, liabilities, and equity. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI-GL and aligned to IFRS/GAAP chart of accounts. Provides the authoritative account classification for all journal entries, AP/AR postings, and financial consolidation.
products.reference: SAP FI-GL Chart of Accounts / IFRS COA

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Primary key for gl_account

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chart of accounts framework to which this account belongs (e.g., 'Corporate COA', 'IFRS COA', 'Local Statutory COA').

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the company code (legal entity) to which this account belongs. Supports multi-entity chart of accounts.

attributes.name: account_class
attributes.description: High-level classification indicating whether the account appears on the balance sheet, Profit and Loss (P&L) statement, or is a statistical (non-financial) account.

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: Grouping code used to aggregate accounts for reporting and analysis (e.g., 'Direct Construction Costs', 'Overhead', 'Operating Expenses', 'Current Assets').

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the account (e.g., 'Construction Materials - Direct Costs', 'Accounts Payable - Trade', 'Revenue - EPC Contracts').

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique account number in the chart of accounts. Typically a 4-10 digit numeric code used in all financial postings and reports.

attributes.name: account_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or label for the account used in condensed reports and user interfaces.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account: active (in use), blocked (no new postings), closed (archived), or pending approval (awaiting activation).

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental financial statement category: asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense. Determines balance sheet vs. Profit and Loss (P&L) classification.

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Alternative or legacy account number used for cross-reference, migration mapping, or external reporting (e.g., statutory chart of accounts).

attributes.name: balance_sheet_classification
attributes.description: Detailed balance sheet line item classification (e.g., 'Current Assets - Cash', 'Non-Current Liabilities - Long-Term Debt', 'Equity - Retained Earnings'). Null for P&L accounts.

attributes.name: cash_flow_classification
attributes.description: Classification for cash flow statement reporting: operating activities, investing activities, financing activities, or not applicable for non-cash accounts.

attributes.name: consolidation_account_number
attributes.description: The corresponding account number in the group consolidation chart of accounts. Used for mapping local entity accounts to group reporting structure.

attributes.name: cost_center_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a cost center must be specified when posting to this account. Enforces cost allocation discipline.

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Classification of the cost element: primary (direct posting from FI), secondary (internal allocation), revenue, or not applicable if not a cost element.

attributes.name: cost_element_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account is also a cost element in the controlling (CO) module, enabling integration with project costing and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) budgets.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Indicates the currency perspective for this account: local (entity currency), group (consolidation currency), transaction (original currency), or project (project-specific currency).

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: Configuration key that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed when posting to this account (e.g., cost center, WBS, profit center).

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Business function or division associated with the account (e.g., 'Project Operations', 'Corporate Overhead', 'Procurement', 'MEP Services'). Used for segment reporting.

attributes.name: line_item_display_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether individual line items (journal entries) are stored and can be displayed for this account. Required for detailed transaction analysis.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this account master record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account master record was last modified.

attributes.name: open_item_management_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether open item management is active for this account (e.g., for clearing transactions like AP/AR, advances, or accruals).

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: Indicates the level at which budgeting and planning are performed for this account (e.g., 'Corporate', 'Division', 'Project', 'Cost Center').

attributes.name: posting_allowed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether direct postings are allowed to this account. False for summary/control accounts that only receive automatic postings.

attributes.name: profit_and_loss_classification
attributes.description: Detailed Profit and Loss (P&L) line item classification (e.g., 'Revenue - Construction Contracts', 'Cost of Sales - Direct Labor', 'Operating Expenses - General & Administrative'). Null for balance sheet accounts.

attributes.name: profit_center_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a profit center must be specified when posting to this account. Supports segment profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) for Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), or asset accounting.

attributes.name: retained_earnings_account_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the retained earnings account used for year-end profit/loss transfer and equity rollforward.

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Default sort key used for line item display and reporting (e.g., posting date, document number, reference). Controls how transactions are ordered.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax classification code indicating how this account is treated for tax purposes (e.g., 'Input Tax', 'Output Tax', 'Non-Taxable', 'Exempt'). Used for VAT/GST reporting.

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: Tolerance group code that defines permissible payment differences, exchange rate variances, and rounding tolerances for this account.

attributes.name: trading_partner_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a trading partner (intercompany entity) must be specified when posting to this account. Used for intercompany eliminations.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this account is valid and available for posting. Supports time-dependent chart of accounts changes.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this account is valid. Null for accounts with no planned end date. Used for account retirement and chart of accounts evolution.

attributes.name: wbs_element_required_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Element Required Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element must be specified when posting to this account. Ensures project-level cost tracking.

tag_set.value: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Element Required Indicator

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this account master record in the system.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core double-entry accounting document and its constituent debit/credit line items, capturing all financial postings in the construction enterprise's general ledger. Each document contains a header (document number, posting date, document type, reference, reversal indicator) and one or more lines specifying GL account, cost center, WBS element, cost code, debit/credit amount, currency, tax code, and assignment fields. Covers standard accruals, cost allocations, revenue recognition entries (percentage-of-completion per IFRS 15), intercompany eliminations, period-end adjustments, reclassifications, and FX revaluation entries. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI-GL and Viewpoint Vista. Provides full project-level financial traceability from trial balance to source transaction for audit and IFRS/GAAP compliance. Owns both header-level and line-level data as a single SSOT.
products.reference: SAP FI Journal Entry / IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry document. Primary key for the journal entry record.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: AR subledger journal entries for revenue recognition, retainage accruals, and client billing adjustments must reference the client account for AR reconciliation and aged-debtor reporting. Construction

attributes.name: company_code_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: journal_entry carries a cost_center_code STRING column but has no FK to the cost_center master. In SAP-style construction accounting, every journal entry is posted to a cost center for management acco

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: journal_entry has a cost_code STRING column but no FK to the cost_code master. Construction journal entries are classified by cost code for job costing and WBS alignment. Adding cost_code_id normalize

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Journal entry posts to a specific GL account; linking to gl_account master eliminates code duplication and enables consistent account attributes.

attributes.name: source_timesheet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.timesheet. Business justification: Payroll journal entry posting process: payroll accruals and labor cost journal entries are generated from approved timesheet batches. This FK enables GL auditors to trace payroll journal entries back

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor_invoice. Business justification: Construction AP journal entries are posted from vendor invoices. A direct FK from journal_entry to vendor_invoice enables GL-to-source-document audit traceability, a standard requirement for construct

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-form assignment field used for additional sorting, grouping, or reconciliation purposes (e.g., invoice number, payment reference).

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area or division for cross-company code reporting and segment analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and compliance.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The credit amount for this journal entry line in the document currency. Zero if this is a debit entry.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the journal entry amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: The debit amount for this journal entry line in the document currency. Zero if this is a credit entry.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document or invoice that originated this journal entry. May differ from posting date for period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this journal entry in the general ledger system. Used for audit trail and reference in financial reports.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry document type. SA=Standard Accrual, AA=Asset Accounting, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, AB=Accounting Document, RV=Reversal Document.

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry. Draft=not yet posted, Posted=finalized in GL, Parked=saved but not posted, Reversed=reversed by another entry, Cancelled=voided.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert document currency amounts to local currency. Applicable for multi-currency transactions.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_type
attributes.description: The type of exchange rate used for currency conversion. Spot=transaction date rate, Average=period average, Budget=budgeted rate, Closing=period-end rate.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year to which this journal entry is assigned. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods, or 13-16 for special closing periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this journal entry is assigned for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-form descriptive text at the document header level explaining the purpose or context of the journal entry.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction requiring elimination during consolidation.

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-form descriptive text at the line item level providing additional context for this specific posting.

attributes.name: local_currency_credit_amount
attributes.description: The credit amount converted to the local currency of the company code for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: local_currency_debit_amount
attributes.description: The debit amount converted to the local currency of the company code for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this journal entry document.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: percentage_of_completion
attributes.description: The percentage of completion used for revenue recognition entries under IFRS 15. Represents the stage of project completion at the time of this journal entry.

attributes.name: posted_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who posted this journal entry to the general ledger, finalizing the transaction.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Represents the moment the entry became final and immutable.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. This is the principal business event timestamp for financial period assignment and reporting.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit code that controls the type of posting (debit or credit) and the account type (GL, customer, vendor, asset). Standard SAP posting keys include 40=GL Debit, 50=GL Credit.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center to which revenues and costs are allocated for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reference_document
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier linking this journal entry to source documents such as invoices, purchase orders, or contracts.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate percentage of completion for revenue recognition. Cost-to-cost=based on costs incurred, Units-delivered=based on deliverables, Milestones=based on project milestones, Time-elapsed=based on time.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previous entry. True if this is a reversal document.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversal. 01=Error Correction, 02=Period-End Adjustment, 03=Accrual Reversal, 04=Reclassification, 05=Other.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount for this journal entry line in the document currency.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to this journal entry line, determining the tax rate and tax account for automatic tax calculation.

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: The trading partner company code for intercompany transactions, used for consolidation and elimination entries.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this journal entry document in the system.

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit or credit line item within a journal entry, capturing the GL account, cost center, WBS element, amount, currency, and posting date for each leg of a double-entry transaction. Enables granular drill-down from trial balance to source transaction for audit and IFRS/GAAP compliance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI-GL line item tables.
products.reference: SAP FI Line Item / GL Line Item

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for this entity representing one leg of a double-entry accounting transaction.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project to which this financial transaction is allocated. Links financial data to project master data for job costing and project P&L.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines need to be allocated to a cost center; replace the existing cost_center_code string with a proper foreign key.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or subcontractor associated with this line item, if applicable. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and vendor spend analysis.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this journal entry line in the local reporting currency of the entity. Used for financial statement preparation and local statutory reporting.

attributes.name: amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this journal entry line in the original transaction currency, before any currency conversion. Enables multi-currency accounting and foreign exchange analysis.

attributes.name: assignment_reference
attributes.description: Additional reference field used for payment allocation, clearing, and reconciliation. Often contains check numbers, wire transfer references, or clearing document numbers.

attributes.name: baseline_amount
attributes.description: The base amount before tax and adjustments, used for payment terms calculation and cash discount determination.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area or division to which this line item is allocated. Supports segment reporting and divisional P&L analysis.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this line item was cleared (matched with a payment or offsetting entry). Null if the item remains open.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the clearing transaction that closed this line item. Used for payment reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is a debit (D) or credit (C) entry in the double-entry accounting system.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document (invoice, receipt, contract) that originated this journal entry line. May differ from posting date due to processing lag.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The payment due date for this line item, calculated based on payment terms and document date. Critical for cash flow management and aging reports.

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this journal entry line was created in the ERP system. Used for audit trail and transaction sequencing.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to local currency. Critical for multi-currency consolidation and FX gain/loss calculation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year to which this journal entry line is assigned. Enables period-over-period financial analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this journal entry line is assigned, based on the posting date and the organization's fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this journal entry line was last modified. Tracks changes for audit compliance and data lineage.

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo for this journal entry line, providing additional context for the transaction. Used for audit trail and user clarification.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry, establishing the order of debit and credit legs within the transaction.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the local reporting currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code applicable to this line item, defining due dates and cash discount conditions. Used for cash flow forecasting and AP/AR aging.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which this journal entry line was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period for financial statement inclusion.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP-specific posting key that controls the account type (GL, vendor, customer) and debit/credit indicator. Used for system-level transaction control.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center responsible for this line item. Enables profitability analysis and internal management reporting by business unit.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: The source document number (invoice number, PO number, payment reference) that originated this journal entry line. Provides audit trail to source transaction.

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: The type of source document that originated this journal entry line. Classifies the transaction origin for audit and reconciliation purposes. attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item is a reversal of a previous entry. Used for error correction tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original entry that this line item reverses. Provides audit trail for corrections and adjustments.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount associated with this line item in local currency. Supports tax reporting and reconciliation to tax authorities.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to this line item, determining the tax rate and tax account posting. Used for VAT, sales tax, and GST compliance reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the original transaction currency.

products.name: project_budget
products.description: Authoritative WBS-linked budget record for each construction project, capturing the approved contract budget, internal target cost, contingency reserves, and management reserve. Tracks original budget, approved change order (CO) adjustments, and current approved budget (CAB) at each WBS level. Integrates with Oracle Primavera P6 baseline data and SAP S/4HANA PS module. Serves as the baseline for EVM (Earned Value Management) calculations including BCWS (Budgeted Cost of Work Scheduled).
products.reference: EVM BCWS / SAP PS Budget / WBS Budget

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project budget record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Project budgets are associated with a cost center; replace the free‑text cost_center column with a foreign key.

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Project budgets reference a cost code; replace the free‑text cost_code column with a foreign key to the cost_code master.

attributes.name: previous_budget_project_budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior version of this budget record if this is a revision. Enables historical tracking and variance analysis across budget versions.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total actual costs incurred to date against this budget. Includes invoiced amounts and accrued costs. Used for EVM Actual Cost of Work Performed (ACWP).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this budget record was formally approved by authorized stakeholders. Triggers budget activation and commitment authority.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this budget. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: approved_change_order_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative sum of all approved change order adjustments to the budget. Includes client-approved scope changes and contract modifications.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Date when this budget was approved and baselined. Establishes the performance measurement baseline for EVM.

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the budget record. Used for external reporting and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the budget line item or WBS budget element. Human-readable identifier for reporting.

attributes.name: budget_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about this budget record. Captures assumptions, constraints, change justifications, and other contextual information.

attributes.name: budget_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the project manager or cost manager responsible for managing this budget. Accountable for budget performance.

attributes.name: budget_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the budget period this record applies to. Defines the time window for budget consumption and variance analysis.

attributes.name: budget_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the budget period this record applies to. Used for time-phased budget tracking and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget record. Approved budgets are baselined; active budgets are in use; frozen budgets are locked for change control.

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget record. Contract budget represents client-approved amounts; internal budget represents target cost; contingency and management reserve represent risk buffers.

attributes.name: budget_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for quantity-based budgets (e.g., cubic meters for concrete, linear meters for piping, hours for labor). Used for unit rate calculations.

attributes.name: budget_variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between current approved budget and actual costs. Positive values indicate under-budget; negative values indicate over-budget.

attributes.name: budgeted_quantity
attributes.description: Planned quantity of work or materials for this budget line. Used with unit rates to calculate total budget amounts.

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total value of purchase orders and subcontracts issued against this budget. Represents contractual obligations not yet invoiced.

attributes.name: contingency_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Budget allocation for identified risks and known-unknowns. Managed by the project manager and released through change control process.

attributes.name: contract_line_item_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific contract line item or BOQ item this budget corresponds to. Links budget to contractual scope and payment terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this budget record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record. Supports multi-currency project accounting.

attributes.name: current_approved_budget
attributes.description: The current total approved budget including original budget plus all approved change orders. This is the active baseline for Earned Value Management (EVM) calculations.

attributes.name: forecast_at_completion
attributes.description: Projected total cost at project completion based on current performance trends. Used for variance analysis and early warning of budget overruns.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of funding for this budget (e.g., client payment, internal investment, joint venture contribution, government grant). Used for cash flow and financial reporting.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record is currently active and available for cost posting. Inactive budgets are closed or superseded.

attributes.name: is_baseline_budget
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record represents the approved performance measurement baseline for EVM. True for baseline budgets used in BCWS calculations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this budget record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: management_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Budget allocation for unknown-unknowns and unidentified risks. Held at executive level and not part of the performance measurement baseline.

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The initial approved budget amount at project baseline. Represents the starting contract value or internal target cost before any change orders.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this budget record. Incremented with each approved change to maintain audit trail of budget evolution.

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: Cost per unit of measure for this budget item. Multiplied by budgeted quantity to derive total budget amount.

Feeds EVM actual cost (ACWP) calculations and CPI (Cost Performance Index) reporting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of this cost transaction: pending (awaiting review), approved (validated and committed), or rejected (not accepted).

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: base_currency_cost

attributes.name: description

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system that last modified this cost transaction record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: reversal_flag

attributes.name: transaction_date

attributes.name: transaction_number

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost transaction: draft (pending approval), posted (committed to ledger), approved (validated), reversed (corrected), or cancelled.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of measure for this transaction. Used to calculate total cost and for rate variance analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the quantity is measured (e.g., hours, cubic meters, tons, each). Aligns with industry standard UOM codes.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user or system that created this cost transaction record. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

products.name: progress_billing
products.description: Construction progress billing, payment certification, and client AR invoice lifecycle record covering the full claim-to-collection cycle. Captures the payment application (AIA G702/G703 or FIDIC payment certificate) including scheduled value by WBS/BOQ line, percentage complete, amount earned to date, current period claim, retention withheld, and net amount due. Also owns the formal AR tax invoice raised after payment certificate approval — invoice number, client reference, contract reference, invoice date, due date, gross amount, VAT/GST, retention deducted, net receivable, payment status, aging bucket, and collection history. Sourced from Procore, SAP S/4HANA FI-AR, and Viewpoint Vista. The authoritative SSOT for all client-facing billing, accounts receivable invoices, and receivables management in construction.
products.reference: AIA G702 Payment Application / FIDIC Interim Payment Certificate

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this progress billing claim.

attributes.description: Client-provided reference number or purchase order number associated with this payment application.

attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the invoice is on hold pending additional information or resolution of issues. True if payment is temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the invoice is on hold. May include missing documentation, pending approvals, or compliance issues.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was issued by the vendor or subcontractor. This is the principal business event timestamp for the invoice and is used for aging analysis and payment term calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique invoice number assigned by the vendor or subcontractor. This is the business identifier used for correspondence, payment reference, and three-way matching.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts payable workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through approval to payment or dispute resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|pending_approval|approved|disputed|on_hold|paid|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice type. Standard invoices are for completed deliveries; progress claims are for work-in-progress per percentage of completion; credit/debit notes are adjustments; prepayments are advance payments; final invoices close out a contract.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The final amount payable to the vendor after applying tax, retention, discounts, and other adjustments. This is the amount that will be paid or has been paid.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date payment was made to the vendor or subcontractor. Null if invoice is unpaid. Used for cash flow analysis and Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) calculation.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used to pay this invoice (e.g., wire transfer, check, ACH, credit card, letter of credit). Used for cash management and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number or transaction ID for the payment made against this invoice. Used for bank reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms for this invoice (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Defines the payment schedule and any early payment discount conditions.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was received and recorded in the accounts payable system. Used for internal processing metrics and aging analysis.

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The amount withheld from payment as retention per contract terms. Typically held until project completion or Defects Liability Period (DLP) expiry. Common in construction contracts per FIDIC terms.

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the invoice amount withheld as retention per contract terms. Typically 5-10% in construction contracts per FIDIC conditions.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax or Value Added Tax (VAT) amount applied to the invoice. Used for tax reporting and compliance with local tax regulations.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The tax or VAT rate applied to this invoice, expressed as a percentage. Used for tax calculation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match validation between Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt (GR), and Invoice. Ensures invoice accuracy and prevents overpayment.

products.name: payment_record
products.description: Financial payment transaction record capturing both outgoing payments to vendors/subcontractors (AP disbursements) and incoming receipts from clients (AR collections). Captures payment date, payment method (wire transfer, cheque, ACH, LC drawdown), bank account, amount paid/received, currency, exchange rate, invoice references cleared, bank clearing status, and remittance advice details. Supports multi-currency payment runs, partial payments, and bank reconciliation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI payment runs and Viewpoint Vista.
